verdict.rationale: An incorporation SaaS like Stripe Atlas could plausibly offer an API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no Atlas API reference, interactive explorer, or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404, and the llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation-format features, not an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
